title: Patient typologization for needs-based and more effective coaching for patients with hormone receptor positive breast cancer
summary:
With the PaTyp study, we want to improve the care of patients suffering from hormone receptor-positive breast cancer. Hormone receptor-positive means that the growth of the cancer cells is promoted by the patient's own hormones. Therefore, after primary therapy, i.e. the removal or destruction of the cancerous tissue, anti-hormonal therapy (adjuvant endocrine therapy) is started in order to prevent the recurrence of breast cancer. The success of this therapy depends on the consequent and long-term use of the anti-hormonal therapy.
The aim of the PaTyp study is to investigate whether adherence to adjuvant endocrine therapy can be improved through personalised coaching.
Firstly, the patient's personality is categorised into one of four types using a few questions. Depending on the type determined, a coaching programme adapted to this personality type is carried out. The coaching is carried out by the medical staff of the participating practices, which have been specially trained.
In order to check whether the coaching adapted to the personality type has an influence on treatment adherence, the coaching is only carried out in half of the participating practices. The other half of the participating practices serve as a control, where standard care continues to be provided.
After one year, we compare the adherence in the practices that have carried out the coaching with the adherence in the practices that have not carried out the coaching. We expect that adherence to adjuvant endocrine therapy will improve as a result of coaching adapted to the personality type.

interventions.name:
Performing a patient typologization and providing communication and coaching concepts adapted to the patient type by specially trained medical professionals.
To measure the primary endpoint, the study participants keep a diary in which they document the intake of hormone therapy.

- Usual care
- Patient typologization
- Diary for endocrine therapy intake

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Inclusion criteria for centres
1. offer follow-up care after primary breast cancer
2. administer endocrine therapies
3. administer parenteral tumour therapies

Inclusion criteria for patients
1. hormone receptor positive breast cancer
2. completed curative primary treatment
3. receiving adjuvant endocrine therapy that was started no more than 8 weeks ago
Exclusion criteria:
Exclusion criteria for institutions
1. participation in other structured follow-up programmes or studies 
2. fewer than 85 patients with primary breast cancer per year

Exclusion criteria for patients
1. metastasised breast cancer
2. participation in aftercare programmes (e.g. Onko-Coach) or aftercare studies (e.g. Better Care)
3. medically diagnosed severe acute depression
